title: 第15章 离开山洞第16章 混沌造化空间
content_zh:
张皓旸通过白色狐狸又蹦又跳的动作和面部兴奋的表情知道它愿意与自己同行，于是就将它抱起，摸着它的小脑袋说道：“为了以后方便交流，我就先给你取个名字吧！
因你全身毛发雪白，那就简单点干脆叫你小白吧！”
白色狐狸在张皓旸的抚摸下眯起双眼，低下头，蜷缩在他的怀里，看上去非常舒服。
当听到张皓旸叫它小白时，这只白色狐狸竟立即抬起头，然后就像一个孩童般连连点头，不停的用小脑袋磨蹭张皓旸的胳膊并用舌头舔他的手，样子甚是乖巧可爱，显然它非常认可小白这个名字。
就在张皓旸抱着小白准备走时，小白却用牙咬着他的衣服，小脑袋则是先向一边摇头然后再向下点头。
张皓旸心想，小白这是什么意思？难道是让他向那边去？小白向他示意的方向正是当初赤面猴捆绑她的位置。
张皓旸抱着小白来到原先捆绑它的位置将它放下，他想看看小白到底要干什么？
小白被张皓旸放下后，只见小白首先用小脑袋碰了碰张皓旸的小腿而后走了几步来到一块黑色石头面前，它用前爪不停抓挠那块黑色的石头。
那块石头是黑色的、椭圆形的，高五十公分左右，看上去比小白略高。
张皓旸看着小白的连番动作，思考一番后好像明白了她的意思。
张皓旸指着地上那块黑色石头对小白说：“你是想让我将它也一起带走对吗？”
小白闻言立即又是一阵点头。
张皓旸看了这块黑不溜秋的椭圆石头一眼，又看了看小白。
心想反正那枚空间戒指里空余的空间还很大，既然小白喜欢，那就将黑色石头带上也无妨！
由于担心赤面猴会跟来，张皓旸行动迅速，非常干脆的将那块黑不溜秋的椭圆石头放入空间戒指之中。
小白看到黑色石头消失不见就知道张皓旸已经将其收起，于是就在原地转了几圈，尾巴左右摇摆，好像非常高兴。
只见它走到张皓旸身旁，用小脑袋不停蹭触张皓旸的腿，好像在示意张皓旸跟着它走。
经过这段时间的交流，张皓旸也基本弄懂了一些小白简单动作的含义，小白刚才的意思是它在前边带路，让张皓旸跟着他走。
张皓旸最后又打量了一下他们站立的位置，看看现场没有什么遗留的东西后就直接跟着小白向山洞深处走去。
一人一兽，小白头前带路，张皓旸则是紧紧跟随，

不知走了多远，只知道时间不短。
一路走来，并没有发现身后有赤面候跟过来，显然他们还没有发现张皓旸已经逃脱。
张皓旸与小白速度很快，一直向山洞深处跑去。
在中间遇到几次岔路口时，张皓旸都毫不犹豫的选择跟着小白。
一人一兽之间信任的建立竟是如此简单！
张皓旸极其信任小白，是他们同时深陷山洞险境希望安全离开的目标一致；另外张皓旸从小白的身上看到了他自己也有的那种孤身一人、无依无靠、一往无前的影子，这也正是他完全信任小白的主要原因所在。
content_en:
Zhang Haoyang knew from the white fox's jumping movements and excited expression on its face that it was willing to go with him, so he picked it up, touched its little head and said, "To facilitate communication in the future, I will give you a name first!"
Since your hair is all white, let’s just call you Xiaobai! "
The white fox narrowed his eyes under Zhang Haoyang's touch, lowered his head, and curled up in his arms, looking very comfortable.
When it heard Zhang Haoyang call it Xiaobai, the white fox immediately raised its head, and then nodded like a child. It kept rubbing its little head against Zhang Haoyang's arm and licking his hand with its tongue. It looked very cute and cute. It obviously recognized the name Xiaobai very much.
Just when Zhang Haoyang was holding Xiaobai and preparing to leave, Xiaobai bit his clothes with his teeth, and his little head shook his head first to one side and then downwards.
Zhang Haoyang thought to himself, what does Xiaobai mean? Are you asking him to go that way? The direction Xiaobai gestured to him was exactly where the red-faced monkey tied her up.
Zhang Haoyang carried Xiaobai to the place where he was originally bound and put him down. He wanted to see what Xiaobai was going to do?
After Xiaobai was put down by Zhang Haoyang, Xiaobai first touched Zhang Haoyang's calf with his little head and then walked a few steps to a black stone. It kept scratching the black stone with its front paws.
The stone was black, oval, about fifty centimeters high, and looked slightly taller than Xiao Bai.
Zhang Haoyang looked at Xiaobai's actions, and after thinking about it for a while, he seemed to understand what she meant.
Zhang Haoyang pointed to the black stone on the ground and said to Xiaobai, "You want me to take it away with you, right?"
Xiaobai nodded again after hearing this.
Zhang Haoyang glanced at the black oval stone and then at Xiaobai.
I thought that there was still a lot of free space in that space ring anyway, and since Xiaobai liked it, there was no harm in bringing the black stone!
Worried that the red-faced monkey would follow, Zhang Haoyang acted quickly and put the black oval stone into the space ring very simply.
When Xiaobai saw the black stone disappear, he knew that Zhang Haoyang had put it away, so he turned around a few times, wagging his tail from side to side, as if he was very happy.
I saw it walking next to Zhang Haoyang and rubbing its little head against Zhang Haoyang's legs, as if to indicate to Zhang Haoyang to follow it.
After this period of communication, Zhang Haoyang basically understood the meaning of some simple actions of Xiaobai. What Xiaobai just meant was that it was leading the way and asking Zhang Haoyang to follow him.
Zhang Haoyang took one last look at where they were standing, and after seeing that there was nothing left at the scene, he followed Xiao Bai deeper into the cave.
One person and one animal, Xiao Baitou led the way, while Zhang Haoyang followed closely.
I don’t know how far I have walked, but I only know that the time has not been short.
Along the way, they didn't notice anyone with a red face following them. Apparently they hadn't noticed that Zhang Haoyang had escaped.
Zhang Haoyang and Xiaobai were very fast and ran deep into the cave.
When encountering several forks in the road, Zhang Haoyang chose to follow Xiaobai without hesitation.
It is so easy to establish trust between one person and one animal!
Zhang Haoyang trusts Xiao Bai extremely much, because they are both trapped in the cave at the same time and hope to escape safely. In addition, Zhang Haoyang sees in Xiao Bai the same shadow of being alone, helpless, and indomitable that he himself has. This is the main reason why he completely trusts Xiao Bai.
